## ProofRoom change

- What user/privacy problem does this change address?
- Which feedback ID or requirement motivated it?
- What changed in the README or release evidence?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run compact`
- [ ] Browser smoke test (when UI changes)
- [ ] No private metrics, balances, identities, seed phrases, or dossier plaintext added
